description: Use at the start of any non-trivial task in a Dotkernel repository, and whenever a convention might differ between projects — to work out whether this is Dotkernel API, Admin, Frontend, Light, Queue or a derived project, and what that implies for handler naming, authorization config, responses, forms, templates, documentation and tests. Also use when a skill's guidance does not match what the repo actually contains, or when the same feature has to be built in more than one Dotkernel project.
